    )

    assert called["count"] == 0


def test_queue_publish_enabled_posts_expected_payload(monkeypatch):
    sync = _sync_stub(enabled=True, webhook="https://example.com/hook", token="tkn")
    captured: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def _fake_post(url, json, headers, timeout):
        captured["url"] = url
        captured["json"] = json
        captured["headers"] = headers
        captured["timeout"] = timeout
        return _Response(200, "ok")

    monkeypatch.setattr(_gmail_sync.requests, "post", _fake_post)

    sync._publish_to_queue(
        "ingestion/gmail/2026/05/id.raw.eml",
        {
            "id": "gmail-3",
            "threadId": "th-3",
            "historyId": "h-3",
            "labelIds": ["INBOX", "IMPORTANT"],
            "internalDate": "1700000000000",
            "sizeEstimate": 123,
        },
        {
            "learning_priority": "IMPORTANT",
            "is_sent": False,
            "is_starred": False,
            "is_important": True,
        },
    )

    assert captured["url"] == "https://example.com/hook"
    assert captured["json"]["eventType"] == "EMAIL"
    assert captured["json"]["r2ObjectKey"] == "ingestion/gmail/2026/05/id.raw.eml"
    assert captured["json"]["metadata"]["gmailMessageId"] == "gmail-3"
    assert captured["headers"]["Authorization"] == "Bearer tkn"
    assert captured["timeout"] == 10


# --- ETH-d0sxo.8: counterparties go through the one contact resolver ---


def test_resolve_contacts_sends_each_counterparty_once_and_skips_owner(monkeypatch):
    from email.message import EmailMessage

    sync = object.__new__(_gmail_sync.GmailSync)
    bodies: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class _Json(_Response):
        def json(self) -> Any:
            return {"decision": "linked", "contact_id": "c1"}

    def _fake_post(url, json, headers, timeout):  # noqa: A002 - matches call signature
        assert url.endswith("/rpc/resolve_contact_identity")
        assert headers["Content-Profile"] == "clients"
        bodies.append(json)
        return _Json()

    monkeypatch.setattr(_gmail_sync.requests, "post", _fake_post)
    monkeypatch.setattr(_gmail_sync, "SUPABASE_URL", "https://example.supabase.co")
    monkeypatch.setattr(_gmail_sync, "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", "test-key")
    monkeypatch.setattr(_gmail_sync, "ACCOUNT_EMAIL", "owner@example.org")
    monkeypatch.delenv("CONTACT_RESOLVER_ENFORCE", raising=False)

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "Pat Example <pat@example.com>"
    msg["To"] = "owner@example.org, lee@example.com"
    msg["Cc"] = "PAT@example.com"
    sync._resolve_contacts(msg)

    assert [(b["p_source_system"], b["p_email"], b["p_name"], b["p_enforce"]) for b in bodies] == [
        ("gmail", "pat@example.com", "Pat Example", False),
        ("gmail", "lee@example.com", None, False),
    ]


def test_upsert_routes_counterparties_only_after_a_successful_write(monkeypatch):
    from email.message import EmailMessage

    sync = object.__new__(_gmail_sync.GmailSync)
    sync._auth_fail_count = 0
    sync._AUTH_FAIL_LIMIT = 3
    urls: list[str] = []
    status = {"upsert": 201}

    class _Json(_Response):
        def json(self) -> Any:
            return {"decision": "would_create"}

    def _fake_post(url, json, headers, timeout):  # noqa: A002 - matches call signature
        urls.append(url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
        if url.endswith("/gmail_messages"):
            return _Response(status["upsert"], "x")
        return _Json()

    monkeypatch.setattr(_gmail_sync.requests, "post", _fake_post)
    monkeypatch.setattr(_gmail_sync, "SUPABASE_URL", "https://example.supabase.co")
    monkeypatch.setattr(_gmail_sync, "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", "test-key")
    monkeypatch.setattr(_gmail_sync, "ACCOUNT_EMAIL", "owner@example.org")

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "pat@example.com"
    msg["To"] = "owner@example.org"
    sync._upsert_to_supabase("m1", {"threadId": "t"}, msg, "k", "sha", [])
    assert urls == ["gmail_messages", "resolve_contact_identity"]

    urls.clear()
    status["upsert"] = 500
    sync._upsert_to_supabase("m2", {"threadId": "t"}, msg, "k", "sha", [])
    assert urls == ["gmail_messages"]

[project]
name = "email-sync"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "Email synchronization service (Gmail API + R2 storage)"
authors = [{ name = "Sloane", email = "sloane@ethicic.com" }]
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
  "google-auth>=2.48.0",
  "google-auth-oauthlib>=1.2.4",
  "google-auth-httplib2>=0.3.0",
  "google-api-python-client>=2.190.0",
  "boto3>=1.42.50",
  "pyarrow>=18.1.0",
  "requests>=2.32.3",
  # supabase SDK removed: only one call site used it (contacts_sync.py upsert)
  # and was replaced with a direct PostgREST POST matching gmail_sync.py /
  # forms_sync.py / drive_email_filer.py. Avoids supabase → storage3 →
  # pyiceberg → pyroaring (which needs gcc to build a Rust extension).
  "reportlab>=4.0",
  "dark-core",
]

[tool.uv.sources]
dark-core = { path = "../../../../packages/python", editable = true }

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
# Script-based project - include src/ directory
packages = ["src"]

[tool.hatch.metadata]
allow-direct-references = true

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0.0", "pytest-cov>=4.0.0", "ruff>=0.8.0", "mypy>=1.0.0"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
python_files = ["test_*.py", "*_test.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]
addopts = ["-v", "--tb=short", "--color=yes"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
  "E",  # pycodestyle errors
  "W",  # pycodestyle warnings
  "F",  # pyflakes
  "I",  # isort
  "B",  # flake8-bugbear
  "C4", # flake8-comprehensions
  "UP", # pyupgrade
]
ignore = [
  "E501", # line too long (handled by formatter)
]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.11"
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
disallow_untyped_defs = false

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = [
  "boto3",
  "botocore",
  "pyarrow",
  "pyarrow.*",
  "requests",
  "googleapiclient",
  "googleapiclient.*",
  "reportlab",
  "reportlab.*",
]
ignore_missing_imports = true

"""Production database safety guard for dark-core package tests.

Incident 2025-11-20: tests overwrote production PostgreSQL, losing 2,467
tick_scores + 6,975 tick_history rows (3+ years). Root cause: DB env vars were
set AFTER the app module had already imported and cached a connection pool
pointed at production.

This suite (``packages/python/tests/``, 60+ files) tests the shared DB layer
itself. Every ``psycopg2.connect`` is patched today, so it is safe by per-test
convention — but under ``bws run -- pytest`` the real ``SUPABASE_DB_URL`` is in
the environment, and one future test that forgets to patch (or a fixture-order
bug) would connect straight to production with zero backstop.

Implements the mandatory 4-step pattern (see
``~/.claude/rules/test-database-isolation.md``). The actual checks live in
the shared ``dark.testing.db_isolation`` module (ETH-l9j7s) so the logic
does not drift independently across the three conftest.py files that need it
-- this file is a thin wrapper:

1. ``pytest_configure()`` neutralizes DB env vars BEFORE any test module is
   imported (runs before collection, so no app code has cached a pool yet).
2. An ``autouse``, session-scoped fixture validates that no DB env var points
   at the production Supabase project. (Env-var-only check: every DB call in
   this suite is mocked, so there is no live connection to independently
   verify -- see ``research/pipeline/tests/conftest.py`` /
   ``research/scripts/tests/conftest.py`` for the stronger live-connection
   check used by suites that can open a real connection.)
3. ``raise RuntimeError`` hard-blocks the session on a production match — it
   does not warn-and-continue.
4. A post-test re-check catches code paths that rebind the DB at runtime.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os

from dark.testing.db_isolation import (
    DB_ENV_VARS,
    PRODUCTION_MARKERS,
    PRODUCTION_PROJECT_ID,
    assert_env_not_production,
    neutralize_db_env_vars,
)

# Git repo-discovery scrub (kata 7cmx, ctz7). A git hook exports GIT_DIR /
# GIT_INDEX_FILE / GIT_WORK_TREE; inherited here, the fixture `git init`/
# `commit` calls in this suite (kanban GC, agents guard, worktree, vmupdater)
# would write into the REAL repo. Same list as scripts/ci/tests/lib_git_scrub.sh,
# held to it by scripts/ci/lint-test-git-scrub.py; popped at import so it
# precedes collection, and re-scrubbed per test by the fixture below.
GIT_SCRUB_VARS = (
    "GIT_DIR",
    "GIT_WORK_TREE",
    "GIT_INDEX_FILE",
    "GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY",
    "GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES",
    "GIT_COMMON_DIR",
    "GIT_PREFIX",
    "GIT_NAMESPACE",
    "GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH",
)
for _var in GIT_SCRUB_VARS:
    os.environ.pop(_var, None)

# Backward-compatible aliases -- this file historically exposed these
# underscore-prefixed names at module scope.
_PRODUCTION_PROJECT_ID = PRODUCTION_PROJECT_ID
_PRODUCTION_MARKERS = PRODUCTION_MARKERS
_DB_ENV_VARS = DB_ENV_VARS


def pytest_configure(config):  # noqa: ARG001  (pytest hook arg name is fixed)
    """Fires before any test module is imported. Neutralize DB env vars."""
    neutralize_db_env_vars(DB_ENV_VARS)


import pytest  # noqa: E402  (must come after pytest_configure is defined)


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True, scope="session")
def _block_production_database():
    """Hard block: refuse to run if any env var points to production."""
    assert_env_not_production("startup")
    yield
    # Post-test validation: catch a test/fixture that rebinds the DB at runtime.
    assert_env_not_production("teardown")


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _scrub_git_discovery_env(monkeypatch):
    for var in GIT_SCRUB_VARS:
        monkeypatch.delenv(var, raising=False)

def header_people(headers: Iterable[str | None], owned: Iterable[str] = ()) -> list[Person]:
    """Distinct people in RFC 5322 header values (From/To/Cc), minus ``owned``.

    Order is first appearance; the first non-empty display name for an address
    wins. The SQL resolver also drops owned addresses -- filtering here only
    saves the round trip for the CIO's own address on every message.
    """
    owned_set = {o.strip().lower() for o in owned if o}
    people: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    for display, addr in getaddresses([h for h in headers if h]):
        norm = addr.strip().lower()
        if "@" not in norm or norm in owned_set:
            continue
        if norm not in people or not people[norm]:
            people[norm] = display.strip() or None
    return list(people.items())


def attendee_people(attendees: Any, owned: Iterable[str] = ()) -> list[Person]:
    """People in a Google Calendar ``attendees`` list.

    Skips the calendar owner (``self``), rooms/equipment (``resource``) and
    ``owned`` addresses. Tolerates a missing or malformed list (returns []).
    """
    if not isinstance(attendees, list):
        return []
    owned_set = {o.strip().lower() for o in owned if o}
    people: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    for att in attendees:
        if not isinstance(att, Mapping) or att.get("self") or att.get("resource"):
            continue
        norm = str(att.get("email") or "").strip().lower()
        if "@" not in norm or norm in owned_set or norm in people:
            continue
        people[norm] = str(att.get("displayName") or "").strip() or None
    return list(people.items())

    post: PostFn,

    source: str,

) -> Counter[str]:
    """Resolve each person; return counts by decision (``failed`` for errors).

    The counts are what a producer logs -- never the addresses.

    counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
    for email, name in people:
        signal = ContactSignal(source=source, email=email, name=name)
        got = resolve_via_rest(post, endpoint, signal, enforce)
        counts[got.decision if got else "failed"] += 1
    return counts

Motivation
----------
email-gmail-sync silently lost 36 days of real-time ingestion in Apr 2026
because of a broken R2 endpoint + Supabase env rename that combined into a
persistent failure mode the container's log output didn't obviously flag.
Gmail's history API has only ~7 days of retention, so any silent failure
longer than that cannot be healed by incremental replay — we need a
date-keyed recovery path (`q="after:YYYY/MM/DD"`).

Public API
----------

    Query MAX(internal_date) FROM comms.gmail_messages and classify the
    gap against GAP_ALERT_HOURS / GAP_BACKFILL_HOURS thresholds.

    lists Gmail messages with `after:YYYY/MM/DD` and calls
    GmailSync()._process_message for each id. Idempotent — _process_message

FROM python:3.15-slim

LABEL maintainer="sloane@ethicic.com"
LABEL description="Gmail API sync with full attachment extraction"

# Install system dependencies
# build-essential needed for pyroaring (C extension; no 3.14 wheels yet)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    build-essential \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install uv
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir uv

# Create working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy shared package to the path uv expects (../../../packages/python from /app = /packages/python)
COPY packages/python /packages/python

# Copy dependency files for this service (build context is repo root)
COPY infra/containers/python/email/pyproject.toml infra/containers/python/email/uv.lock ./

# Rewrite repo-relative path deps to the image-local shared package path.
RUN python -c "from pathlib import Path; paths=[Path('pyproject.toml'), Path('uv.lock')]; [p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('../../../packages/python', '/packages/python')) for p in paths if p.exists()]"

# Install Python dependencies with uv (including dark-core path dep)
# --no-install-project: skip building email-sync as a package (it's a script container)
RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-install-project || uv sync --no-dev --no-install-project

# Copy source code
COPY infra/containers/python/email/src/gmail_sync.py .

# Create state directory
RUN mkdir -p /state /maildir /run/secrets

# Set environment variables
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

# Entrypoint writes GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON (injected by bws run) to tmpfs.
# Host filesystem never sees the key.
COPY infra/containers/python/email/.docker/entrypoint.sh /entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /entrypoint.sh

# Root-owned persistent volume (/state, /maildir) populated by prior deploys;
# non-root migration needs a coordinated volume chown at deploy — tracked in
# ETH-mown9. Explicit USER root documents the current (deferred) state.
# trivy:ignore:AVD-DS-0002
USER root

ENTRYPOINT ["/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["uv", "run", "python", "gmail_sync.py"]
    line = lines[0]

def test_crontab_resolves_gmail_sync_container_by_prefix() -> None:
    text = (CONTAINER_ROOT / "crontab").read_text()

    bws-run python3 get_gmail_refresh_token.py

Requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in environment (from BWS).

import os

from google_auth_oauthlib.flow import InstalledAppFlow

# Gmail API scopes
SCOPES = [
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly",
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify",
    "https://mail.google.com/",

]

    client_secret = REDACTED

        print("Run with: bws-run python3 get_gmail_refresh_token.py")

            "client_id": client_id,
            "client_secret": client_secret,
            "auth_uri": "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth",

    print("3. You'll see 'authentication successful' message")
    print("")

    flow = InstalledAppFlow.from_client_config(client_config, SCOPES)
    creds = flow.run_local_server(port=0)

    print("")
    print("✅ Success! Here's your refresh token:")
    print("")
    print(creds.refresh_token)
    print("")
    print("To save to BWS:")
    print(f"bws secret edit GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN='REDACTED' -p rawls -c prd")


if __name__ == "__main__":

# Google OAuth Setup for Gmail Sync

## Three Secrets You Need

### 1. GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID

**Source**: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials

- Format: `123456789-abc123def456.apps.googleusercontent.com`
- This is NOT sensitive, it's public

### 2. GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET

**Source**: Same credentials page

- Format: `GOCSPX-abc123def456...`
- This IS sensitive, keep it secret

### 3. GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN

**Source**: Run OAuth flow to get it

- Format: `1//0gXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX...` (long string)
- This IS sensitive - it's your persistent access token

---

## How to Get the Refresh Token

### Option 1: Use OAuth Playground

1. Go to https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground
2. Click gear icon → Check "Use your own OAuth credentials"
3. Enter your Client ID and Client Secret
4. In Step 1: Select "Gmail API v1" → `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly`
5. Click "Authorize APIs"
6. Sign in with your Google account
7. In Step 2: Click "Exchange authorization code for tokens"
8. Copy the `refresh_token` value

### Option 2: Use Python Script

```python
from google_auth_oauthlib.flow import InstalledAppFlow

# Download credentials.json from Google Cloud Console
# (OAuth 2.0 Client ID → Desktop app)

SCOPES = ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly"]

flow = InstalledAppFlow.from_client_secrets_file("credentials.json", SCOPES)
creds = flow.run_local_server(port=0)

print(f"Refresh Token: {creds.refresh_token}")
```

"""data-pipelines/storage/google_oauth_refresh.py must never print a credential (ETH-krxln).

The script printed `refresh_token[:20]`, dumped the whole token response on
failure, and on a failed `bws` write echoed the FULL token. This drives the
script's response handler with a mocked Google reply (no network) and asserts
no token-like value, nor any slice of one, reaches stdout or stderr on the
success and failure paths. It lives here because this project's pytest is the
one CI collects; the script is stdlib-only and loaded by path.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import stat
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5] / "data-pipelines/storage/google_oauth_refresh.py"

REFRESH = "1//REDACTED"
ACCESS = "ya29.REDACTED"
ID_TOKEN = "REDACTED"
CLIENT_SECRET = "REDACTED"
SECRETS = (REFRESH, ACCESS, ID_TOKEN, CLIENT_SECRET)


@pytest.fixture
def oauth(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    monkeypatch.setenv("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID", "public-client-id.apps.googleusercontent.com")
    monkeypatch.setenv("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET", CLIENT_SECRET)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("google_oauth_refresh_under_test", SCRIPT)
    assert spec
    assert spec.loader, f"cannot load {SCRIPT}"
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    # The script logs to stdout via logging; configure it as main() does so
    # the assertions below see what an operator would.
    mod.configure_logging()
    monkeypatch.setattr(mod, "_get_json", lambda *_a, **_k: (200, {}))

    def fake_mkdtemp(prefix: str = "") -> str:
        d = tmp_path / f"{prefix}x"
        d.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        return str(d)

    monkeypatch.setattr(mod.tempfile, "mkdtemp", fake_mkdtemp)
    return mod


def _assert_clean(captured) -> None:
    text = captured.out + captured.err
    for secret in SECRETS:
        for i in range(len(secret) - 7):

"""One receipt line per behaviour per message.

Every behaviour in this package returns a :class:`Receipt` and the pipeline
logs it as a single line that names the behaviour, so a log reader can answer
"did step X happen for message Y" without reading code:

    receipt behaviour=archive_raw_message account=workspace message=18c2f... outcome=written key=ingestion/gmail/18c2f....eml

Receipts carry ids, keys, counts and outcomes only -- never an address, a
subject, a body or a credential.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

logger = logging.getLogger("dark.mailbox_archive")

# Outcomes a receipt can carry. "disabled" means the behaviour is switched off
# by configuration; "skipped" means it ran and found nothing to do.
WRITTEN = "written"
SKIPPED = "skipped"
DISABLED = "disabled"
FAILED = "failed"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Receipt:
    behaviour: str
    account: str
    message: str
    outcome: str
    detail: dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def line(self) -> str:
        parts = [
            "receipt",
            f"behaviour={self.behaviour}",
            f"account={self.account}",
            f"message={self.message}",
            f"outcome={self.outcome}",
        ]
        parts.extend(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(self.detail.items()))
        return " ".join(parts)


def emit_receipt(receipt: Receipt) -> Receipt:
    """Log the receipt line (WARNING for failures, INFO otherwise)."""
    level = logging.WARNING if receipt.outcome == FAILED else logging.INFO
    logger.log(level, receipt.line())
    return receipt

``delegated`` uses ``dark.google.get_gmail()`` unchanged (service account,
subject ``ACCOUNT_EMAIL``). ``refresh_token`` reads the three variables the
account names and builds an OAuth client. Values are read here, passed
straight to the Google client and never logged; a missing variable is
reported by NAME only.

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any

from .account import DELEGATED, MailboxAccount


class MissingCredential(RuntimeError):
    """A variable the account needs is absent. The message names it, never a value."""

"""
Google API client factories for monocloud containers.

Auth priority:
1. GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON  — service account with domain-wide delegation (preferred,
   no expiry, no token rotation). Impersonates ACCOUNT_EMAIL (default: sloane@ethicic.com).
2. GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN + GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID + GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET  — OAuth2 refresh token
   fallback for contexts where domain-wide delegation is unavailable (local dev, scripts).

Usage:
    from dark.google import get_gmail, get_calendar, get_drive, get_people, get_drive_activity

    service = get_gmail()
    results = service.users().messages().list(userId="me").execute()

Google packages (google-api-python-client, google-auth) are not listed as hard deps of
dark-core — containers that use this module must declare them in their own
pyproject.toml. Imports are deferred to call time so containers that don't use Google
APIs don't pay the import cost.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os


def _get_credentials(scopes: list[str]):
    """
    Return Google credentials for the given scopes.

    Auth priority:
    1. GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS — path to service account JSON file
       (standard Google env var; avoids multiline env var issues in Docker)
    2. GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON — service account JSON as a string
    3. GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN + GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID + GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET — OAuth2 fallback

    Raises RuntimeError if none are configured.
    """
    subject = os.getenv("ACCOUNT_EMAIL", "sloane@ethicic.com")

    sa_file = os.getenv("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS")
    if sa_file:
        from google.oauth2 import service_account  # type: ignore[import-not-found]

        return service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_file(
            sa_file, scopes=scopes, subject=subject
        )

    sa_json = os.getenv("GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON")
    if sa_json:
        from google.oauth2 import service_account  # type: ignore[import-not-found]

        info = json.loads(sa_json)
        return service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_info(
            info, scopes=scopes, subject=subject
        )

    refresh_token = REDACTED
    client_id = os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
    client_secret = REDACTED

    if refresh_token and client_id and client_secret:
        from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials  # type: ignore[import-not-found]

        # Do NOT pass scopes= here — the refresh token is already authorized for a fixed
        # set of scopes (e.g. https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive). Passing a different
        # scope string (even a sub-scope like drive.readonly) causes invalid_scope errors
        # because Google requires an exact match against what was originally authorized.
        return Credentials(
            token=None,
            refresh_token=REDACTED,
            token_uri="https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
            client_id=client_id,
            client_secret=REDACTED,
        )

    raise RuntimeError(
        "No Google credentials configured. Set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS (file path), "
        "GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON (JSON string), or "
        "GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN + GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID + GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET."
    )

    """

    Scope: https://mail.google.com/ (full access — required for watch/history APIs)
    """
    from googleapiclient.discovery import build  # type: ignore[import-not-found]

    creds = _get_credentials(["https://mail.google.com/"])

"""Behaviour: archive_attachments -- every attachment part to R2, content-addressed.

Key: ``<prefix>attachments/<sha256>-<sanitised filename>``. The key is a
function of the bytes, so rewriting it is harmless and no HEAD is needed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
from typing import Any

from .account import MailboxAccount
from .raw_message import RawMessage
from .receipts import SKIPPED, WRITTEN, Receipt

BEHAVIOUR = "archive_attachments"

_SAFE = set("REDACTED._- ")


def sanitize_filename(filename: str) -> str:
    filename = "".join(c if c in _SAFE else "_" for c in filename)
    if len(filename) > 200:
        name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
        filename = name[:190] + ext
    return filename


def attachment_parts(msg: RawMessage) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """The attachment parts of a message, with their bytes. Pure; no I/O."""
    found: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for part in msg.parsed.walk():
        if part.get_content_maintype() == "multipart":
            continue
        disposition = part.get("Content-Disposition", "") or ""
        content_id = (part.get("Content-ID", "") or "").strip("<>")
        filename = part.get_filename()
        if not filename and "attachment" not in disposition.lower():
            continue
        payload = part.get_payload(decode=True)
        if not payload:
            continue
        sha256 = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
        found.append(
            {
                "filename": sanitize_filename(filename or f"attachment-{sha256[:8]}"),
                "mime_type": part.get_content_type(),
                "size_bytes": len(payload),
                "sha256": sha256,
                "content_id": content_id or None,
                "disposition": "inline"
                if (content_id or "inline" in disposition.lower())
                else "attachment",
                "payload": payload,
            }
        )
    return found


def archive_attachments(
    r2: Any, bucket: str, account: MailboxAccount, msg: RawMessage
) -> tuple[Receipt, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Upload each part; return the receipt and the manifest (without bytes)."""
    manifest: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for att in attachment_parts(msg):
        payload = att.pop("payload")
        key = account.attachment_key(att["sha256"], att["filename"])
        r2.put_object(
            Bucket=bucket,
            Key=key,
            Body=payload,
            ContentType=att["mime_type"],
            Metadata={
                "message-id": msg.id,
                "sha256": att["sha256"],
                "filename": att["filename"],
                "content-id": att["content_id"] or "",
                "disposition": att["disposition"],
            },
        )
        manifest.append({**att, "r2_key": key})
    outcome = WRITTEN if manifest else SKIPPED
    return Receipt(BEHAVIOUR, account.slug, msg.id, outcome, {"count": len(manifest)}), manifest

"""Behaviours: snapshot_labels, record_label_change, snapshot_label_catalog.

Gmail's own labels (SPAM, TRASH, CATEGORY_*, IMPORTANT, user labels) are a
witness: what Gmail's filters and the mailbox owner decided about a message,
and when. These behaviours keep that witness as append-only R2 objects:

``<prefix>label-snapshots/<msg id>/<history id>.json``

"""Behaviour: archive_attachments -- every attachment part to R2, content-addressed.

Key: ``<prefix>attachments/<sha256>-<sanitised filename>``. The key is a
function of the bytes, so rewriting it is harmless and no HEAD is needed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
from typing import Any

from .account import MailboxAccount
from .raw_message import RawMessage
from .receipts import SKIPPED, WRITTEN, Receipt

BEHAVIOUR = "archive_attachments"

_SAFE = set("REDACTED._- ")


def sanitize_filename(filename: str) -> str:
    filename = "".join(c if c in _SAFE else "_" for c in filename)
    if len(filename) > 200:
        name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
        filename = name[:190] + ext
    return filename


def attachment_parts(msg: RawMessage) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """The attachment parts of a message, with their bytes. Pure; no I/O."""
    found: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for part in msg.parsed.walk():
        if part.get_content_maintype() == "multipart":
            continue
        disposition = part.get("Content-Disposition", "") or ""
        content_id = (part.get("Content-ID", "") or "").strip("<>")
        filename = part.get_filename()
        if not filename and "attachment" not in disposition.lower():
            continue
        payload = part.get_payload(decode=True)
        if not payload:
            continue
        sha256 = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
        found.append(
            {
                "filename": sanitize_filename(filename or f"attachment-{sha256[:8]}"),
                "mime_type": part.get_content_type(),
                "size_bytes": len(payload),
                "sha256": sha256,
                "content_id": content_id or None,
                "disposition": "inline"
                if (content_id or "inline" in disposition.lower())
                else "attachment",
                "payload": payload,
            }
        )
    return found


def archive_attachments(
    r2: Any, bucket: str, account: MailboxAccount, msg: RawMessage
) -> tuple[Receipt, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Upload each part; return the receipt and the manifest (without bytes)."""
    manifest: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for att in attachment_parts(msg):
        payload = att.pop("payload")
        key = account.attachment_key(att["sha256"], att["filename"])
        r2.put_object(
            Bucket=bucket,
            Key=key,
            Body=payload,
            ContentType=att["mime_type"],
            Metadata={
                "message-id": msg.id,
                "sha256": att["sha256"],
                "filename": att["filename"],
                "content-id": att["content_id"] or "",
                "disposition": att["disposition"],
            },
        )
        manifest.append({**att, "r2_key": key})
    outcome = WRITTEN if manifest else SKIPPED
    return Receipt(BEHAVIOUR, account.slug, msg.id, outcome, {"count": len(manifest)}), manifest

"""Behaviour: index_row -- one row per message in ``comms.gmail_messages``.

A PostgREST upsert (``merge-duplicates``) keyed on the Gmail id. R2 is the
durable copy and the row can always be rebuilt from it, so an HTTP failure is
a ``failed`` receipt, never an exception -- except repeated 401s, which mean
the key is wrong and every later row would fail too (:class:`IndexAuthFailure`).

The table has no account column. Rows from a second mailbox would be
indistinguishable from the workspace mailbox's, which is why ``index_rows``
is off by default for refresh-token accounts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from dark.contacts.identity_resolver import RestEndpoint

from .account import MailboxAccount
from .raw_message import RawMessage
from .receipts import DISABLED, FAILED, WRITTEN, Receipt

BEHAVIOUR = "index_row"
AUTH_FAIL_LIMIT = 3


class IndexAuthFailure(RuntimeError):
    """PostgREST rejected the service key AUTH_FAIL_LIMIT times in a row."""


def build_index_row(
    msg: RawMessage, r2_key: str, attachments: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The row, exactly as the pre-split gmail_sync wrote it. Pure."""
    gmail = msg.gmail
    email = msg.parsed
    label_ids = gmail.get("labelIds", []) or []
    internal_date_ms = int(gmail.get("internalDate", 0) or 0)
    return {
        "id": msg.id,
        "gmail_message_id": msg.id,
        "gmail_thread_id": gmail.get("threadId"),
        "thread_id": gmail.get("threadId"),
        "message_id": email.get("Message-ID"),
        "from_hdr": email.get("From"),
        "to_hdr": email.get("To"),
        "cc_hdr": email.get("Cc"),
        "bcc_hdr": email.get("Bcc"),
        "subject": email.get("Subject", "(no subject)"),
        "internal_date": internal_date_ms or None,
        "size": int(gmail.get("sizeEstimate", 0) or 0),
        "has_attachments": bool(attachments),
        "r2_object_key": r2_key,
        "sha256": msg.sha256,
        "label_ids": json.dumps(label_ids),
        "labels": label_ids,
    }


class IndexWriter:
    """Holds the consecutive-401 count across messages in one run."""

    def __init__(self, post: Callable[..., Any], endpoint: RestEndpoint | None) -> None:
        self.post = post
        self.endpoint = endpoint
        self.auth_failures = 0

    def index_row(self, account: MailboxAccount, row: dict[str, Any]) -> Receipt:
        msg_id = str(row["id"])
        if not account.index_rows:
            return Receipt(BEHAVIOUR, account.slug, msg_id, DISABLED)
        if self.endpoint is None or not self.endpoint.supabase_url:
            return Receipt(BEHAVIOUR, account.slug, msg_id, DISABLED, {"reason": "no-endpoint"})
        key = self.endpoint.service_key
        try:
            resp = self.post(
                f"{self.endpoint.supabase_url}/rest/v1/gmail_messages",
                json=row,
                headers={
                    "apikey": key,
                    "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "Content-Profile": "comms",
                    "Prefer": "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal",
                },
                timeout=15,
            )
        except Exception as err:  # network: R2 copy stands, row is rebuildable
            return Receipt(
                BEHAVIOUR, account.slug, msg_id, FAILED, {"error": type(err).__name__}
            )
        if resp.status_code in (200, 201):
            self.auth_failures = 0
            return Receipt(BEHAVIOUR, account.slug, msg_id, WRITTEN)
        if resp.status_code == 401:
            self.auth_failures += 1
            if self.auth_failures >= AUTH_FAIL_LIMIT:
                raise IndexAuthFailure(
                    f"comms.gmail_messages rejected the service key {self.auth_failures} times"
                )
        return Receipt(BEHAVIOUR, account.slug, msg_id, FAILED, {"status": resp.status_code})

"""gmail-mailbox-archive: the per-message pipeline and the two walks over a mailbox.

Per message (``archive_message``), in order, one receipt each:

1. archive_raw_message          R2 ``<prefix><id>.eml``                 always
2. archive_attachments          R2 ``<prefix>attachments/...``           always
3. snapshot_labels              R2 ``<prefix>label-snapshots/...``       account.snapshot_labels
4. index_row                    ``comms.gmail_messages``                 account.index_rows
5. resolve_contacts             contact resolver RPC, after a written row account.resolve_contacts
6. publish_to_enrichment_queue  legacy webhook                           GMAIL_SYNC_QUEUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED

The Altruist deposit parser (``deposit_notice``) is NOT a step: disabled
since 2026-03-10.

Walks:

``backfill``     ``messages.list`` in phases SENT, STARRED, IMPORTANT, then all
                 (``includeSpamTrash`` per account), resumable by page token.
``incremental``  ``history.list`` from the stored historyId, every page,
                 ``historyTypes`` per account; messagesAdded -> archive_message,
                 labelsAdded/labelsRemoved -> record_label_change. A 404 (history
                 older than Gmail keeps) falls back to backfill, which is
                 idempotent because archive_raw_message HEADs first.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from dark.contacts.identity_resolver import RestEndpoint

from .attachments import archive_attachments

logger = logging.getLogger("dark.mailbox_archive")

JOB = "gmail-mailbox-archive"
BACKFILL_PHASES: tuple[str | None, ...] = ("SENT", "STARRED", "IMPORTANT", None)


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _http_status(err: Exception) -> int | None:
    resp = getattr(err, "resp", None)
    return getattr(resp, "status", None)

    def __init__(
        self,
        account: MailboxAccount,
        gmail: Any,
        r2: Any,
        bucket: str,
        *,
        post: Callable[..., Any],
        supabase: RestEndpoint | None = None,
        queue: QueueEndpoint | None = None,
        emit: Callable[[Receipt], Any] = emit_receipt,
        clock: Callable[[], str] = _now,
    ) -> None:
        self.account = account
        self.gmail = gmail

"""dark.mailbox_archive: one test group per behaviour, plus the two walks.

Inputs are SHAPE fixtures (tests/gmail_api_shape_fixtures.py), not mail.
No network: R2, Gmail and PostgREST are in-memory fakes. No database: every
HTTP write goes to a recording fake ``post``; the package conftest also
neutralises DB env vars (test-database isolation).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from dark.contacts.identity_resolver import RestEndpoint
from dark.mailbox_archive import (
    IndexAuthFailure,
    IndexWriter,
    MailboxArchive,
    QueueEndpoint,
    Receipt,
    account_from_env,
    archive_attachments,
    archive_raw_message,
    build_index_row,
    decode_raw,
    emit_receipt,
    parse_altruist_deposit_notice,
    publish_to_enrichment_queue,
    record_label_change,
    refresh_token_env_name,
    resolve_contacts,
    snapshot_label_catalog,
    snapshot_labels,
)
from dark.mailbox_archive import deposit_notice
from dark.mailbox_archive.gmail_service import MissingCredential, connect_gmail

from tests import gmail_api_shape_fixtures as shape

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- fakes


class FakeR2:
    def __init__(self, present: set[str] | None = None, head_error: str = "404") -> None:
        self.objects: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {k: {} for k in (present or set())}
        self.puts: list[str] = []
        self.head_error = head_error

    def head_object(self, Bucket: str, Key: str) -> dict:  # noqa: N803 - boto3 names
        if Key in self.objects:
            return {}
        err = Exception("missing")
        err.response = {"Error": {"Code": self.head_error}, "ResponseMetadata": {}}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        raise err

    def put_object(self, Bucket: str, Key: str, Body: bytes, **kw: Any) -> None:  # noqa: N803
        self.objects[Key] = {"Body": Body, **kw}
        self.puts.append(Key)


class Resp:
    def __init__(self, status: int = 201, body: Any = None) -> None:
        self.status_code = status
        self.text = "x"
        self._body = body if body is not None else {"decision": "linked"}

    def json(self) -> Any:
        return self._body


class FakePost:
    def __init__(self, status: int = 201) -> None:
        self.status = status
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []

    def __call__(self, url: str, json: Any, headers: dict, timeout: float) -> Resp:  # noqa: A002
        self.calls.append((url, json))
        if url.endswith("/gmail_messages"):
            return Resp(self.status)
        return Resp(200)


class _Exec:
    def __init__(self, fn, kw):
        self.fn, self.kw = fn, kw

    def execute(self):
        return self.fn(**self.kw)


class FakeGmail:
    """users().messages()/history()/labels()/getProfile() over shape fixtures."""

    def __init__(self, messages: dict[str, dict], lists: list[dict] | None = None,
                 history: list[Any] | None = None) -> None:
        self.messages_by_id = messages
        self.lists = list(lists or [])
        self.history_pages = list(history or [])
        self.list_calls: list[dict] = []
        self.history_calls: list[dict] = []

    def users(self):
        return self

    def messages(self):
        return self

    def history(self):
        return self

    def labels(self):
        return _Labels()

    def get(self, **kw):
        return _Exec(lambda **k: self.messages_by_id[k["id"]], kw)

    def list(self, **kw):
        if "startHistoryId" in kw:
            def _h(**k):
                self.history_calls.append(k)
                page = self.history_pages.pop(0)
                if isinstance(page, Exception):
                    raise page
                return page
            return _Exec(_h, kw)

        def _l(**k):
            self.list_calls.append(k)
            return self.lists.pop(0) if self.lists else {"resultSizeEstimate": 0}
        return _Exec(_l, kw)

    def getProfile(self, **kw):  # noqa: N802 - Gmail API name
        return _Exec(lambda **k: {"emailAddress": shape.OWNER, "historyId": "12345"}, kw)


class _Labels:
    def list(self, **kw):
        return _Exec(lambda **k: shape.labels_list(), kw)


def workspace(tmp_path: Path, **extra: str):
    return account_from_env({"GMAIL_ARCHIVE_STATE_FILE": str(tmp_path / "s.json"),
                             "ACCOUNT_EMAIL": shape.OWNER, **extra})


def personal(tmp_path: Path, **extra: str):
    return account_from_env({
        "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_AUTH": "refresh_token",
        "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_ACCOUNT_SLUG": "personal-1",
        "ACCOUNT_EMAIL": "someone@gmail.example",
        "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_STATE_FILE": str(tmp_path / "p.json"),
        **extra,
    })


ENDPOINT = RestEndpoint("https://example.supabase.co", "test-key")
NOW = "2026-11-05T00:00:00+00:00"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- account


def test_workspace_defaults_reproduce_pre_split_behaviour():
    a = account_from_env({})
    assert (a.auth, a.slug, a.email) == ("delegated", "workspace", "sloane@ethicic.com")
    assert a.raw_key("m1") == "ingestion/gmail/m1.eml"
    assert a.attachment_key("abc", "f.pdf") == "ingestion/gmail/attachments/abc-f.pdf"
    assert str(a.state_file) == "/state/gmail_sync_state.json"
    assert a.history_types == ("messageAdded",)
    assert not a.include_spam_trash and not a.snapshot_labels
    assert a.index_rows and a.resolve_contacts and not a.publish_enrichment


def test_personal_defaults_archive_everything_but_stay_out_of_business_tables(tmp_path):
    a = personal(tmp_path)
    assert a.raw_key("m1") == "ingestion/gmail-accounts/personal-1/m1.eml"
    assert a.include_spam_trash and a.snapshot_labels
    assert a.history_types == ("messageAdded", "labelAdded", "labelRemoved")
    assert not a.index_rows and not a.resolve_contacts and not a.publish_enrichment
    assert a.refresh_token_env == "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_PERSONAL_1_REFRESH_TOKEN"
    assert a.client_id_env == "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "env",
    [
        {"GMAIL_ARCHIVE_AUTH": "password"},
        {"GMAIL_ARCHIVE_AUTH": "refresh_token", "ACCOUNT_EMAIL": "a@b.c"},
        {"GMAIL_ARCHIVE_AUTH": "refresh_token", "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_ACCOUNT_SLUG": "x"},
        {"GMAIL_ARCHIVE_ACCOUNT_SLUG": "Has Spaces"},
        {"GMAIL_ARCHIVE_HISTORY_TYPES": "messageAdded,everything"},
    ],
)
def test_bad_account_config_is_refused(env):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        account_from_env(env)


def test_refresh_token_env_name_is_the_bws_secret_name():
    assert refresh_token_env_name("gmail-2") == "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_GMAIL_2_REFRESH_TOKEN"


def test_connect_gmail_names_missing_variables_without_values(tmp_path):
    a = personal(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(MissingCredential) as err:
        connect_gmail(a, {"GMAIL_ARCHIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID": "public-id"})
    text = str(err.value)
    assert "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_PERSONAL_1_REFRESH_TOKEN" in text
    assert "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET" in text
    assert "public-id" not in text


def test_connect_gmail_refresh_token_never_uses_the_service_account(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from dark.google import clients

    seen: dict[str, str] = {}
    monkeypatch.setattr(clients, "gmail_from_refresh_token", lambda **kw: seen.update(kw) or "svc")
    monkeypatch.setattr(clients, "get_gmail", lambda: pytest.fail("service account path used"))
    env = {
        "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_PERSONAL_1_REFRESH_TOKEN": "rt-sentinel",
        "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID": "cid",
        "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET": "cs",
        "GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON": "{}",
    }
    assert connect_gmail(personal(tmp_path), env) == "svc"
    assert seen == {"refresh_token": "rt-sentinel", "client_id": "cid", "client_secret": "cs"}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- receipts


def test_receipt_line_names_the_behaviour(caplog):
    caplog.set_level(logging.INFO, logger="dark.mailbox_archive")
    emit_receipt(Receipt("archive_raw_message", "workspace", "m1", "written", {"key": "k"}))
    assert caplog.records[-1].getMessage() == (
        "receipt behaviour=archive_raw_message account=workspace message=m1 outcome=written key=k"
    )


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- archive_raw_message


def test_archive_raw_message_writes_once_then_skips(tmp_path):
    a, r2 = workspace(tmp_path), FakeR2()
    msg = decode_raw(shape.message_raw("m1"))
    first = archive_raw_message(r2, "lake", a, msg)
    second = archive_raw_message(r2, "lake", a, msg)
    assert (first.outcome, second.outcome) == ("written", "skipped")
    assert r2.puts == ["ingestion/gmail/m1.eml"]
    stored = r2.objects["ingestion/gmail/m1.eml"]
    assert stored["Body"] == msg.raw and stored["ContentType"] == "message/rfc822"
    assert stored["Metadata"]["sha256"] == msg.sha256


def test_archive_raw_message_treats_garage_400_as_missing(tmp_path):
    r2 = FakeR2(head_error="BadRequest")
    r = archive_raw_message(r2, "lake", workspace(tmp_path), decode_raw(shape.message_raw("m1")))
    assert r.outcome == "written"


def test_archive_raw_message_propagates_unexpected_head_errors(tmp_path):
    r2 = FakeR2(head_error="AccessDenied")
    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="missing"):
        archive_raw_message(r2, "lake", workspace(tmp_path), decode_raw(shape.message_raw("m1")))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- archive_attachments


def test_archive_attachments_content_addresses_and_sanitises(tmp_path):
    r2 = FakeR2()
    receipt, manifest = archive_attachments(
        r2, "lake", workspace(tmp_path), decode_raw(shape.message_raw("m1"))
    )
    assert receipt.outcome == "written" and receipt.detail == {"count": 1}
    (att,) = manifest
    assert att["filename"] == "statement _Q3__final.pdf"
    assert att["r2_key"] == f"ingestion/gmail/attachments/{att['sha256']}-statement _Q3__final.pdf"
    assert "payload" not in att and r2.puts == [att["r2_key"]]


def test_archive_attachments_none(tmp_path):
    raw = shape.rfc822(with_attachment=False)
    receipt, manifest = archive_attachments(
        FakeR2(), "lake", workspace(tmp_path), decode_raw(shape.message_raw("m1", raw=raw))
    )
    assert (receipt.outcome, manifest) == ("skipped", [])


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- labels


def test_snapshot_labels_keyed_by_history_id(tmp_path):
    r2 = FakeR2()
    msg = shape.message_raw("m1", labels=["SPAM", "UNREAD"], history_id="777")
    r = snapshot_labels(r2, "lake", personal(tmp_path), msg, NOW)
    key = "ingestion/gmail-accounts/personal-1/label-snapshots/m1/777.json"
    assert (r.outcome, r.detail["key"]) == ("written", key)
    record = json.loads(r2.objects[key]["Body"])
    assert record["label_ids"] == ["SPAM", "UNREAD"] and record["source"] == "fetch"
    assert "raw" not in record and "snippet" not in record


def test_snapshot_labels_disabled_for_workspace_by_default(tmp_path):
    r2 = FakeR2()
    r = snapshot_labels(r2, "lake", workspace(tmp_path), shape.message_raw("m1"), NOW)
    assert r.outcome == "disabled" and r2.puts == []


def test_record_label_change_captures_spam_marking_and_unmarking(tmp_path):
    r2 = FakeR2()
    a = personal(tmp_path)
    added = record_label_change(
        r2, "lake", a, shape.history_label_added("501", "m1", ["SPAM"], ["SPAM"]), NOW
    )
    removed = record_label_change(
        r2, "lake", a, shape.history_label_removed("502", "m1", ["SPAM"], ["INBOX"]), NOW
    )
    assert [r.detail["change"] for r in added + removed] == ["added", "removed"]
    rec = json.loads(r2.objects[a.label_snapshot_key("m1", "501")]["Body"])
    assert (rec["changed_label_ids"], rec["label_ids"], rec["source"]) == (
        ["SPAM"], ["SPAM"], "history")


def test_snapshot_label_catalog_writes_only_on_change(tmp_path):
    r2, a = FakeR2(), personal(tmp_path)
    first = snapshot_label_catalog(r2, "lake", a, shape.labels_list())
    again = snapshot_label_catalog(r2, "lake", a, shape.labels_list())
    assert (first.outcome, again.outcome) == ("written", "skipped")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- index_row


def test_build_index_row_matches_pre_split_columns(tmp_path):
    msg = decode_raw(shape.message_raw("m1"))
    row = build_index_row(msg, "ingestion/gmail/m1.eml", [{"x": 1}])
    assert row["id"] == row["gmail_message_id"] == "m1"
    assert row["thread_id"] == row["gmail_thread_id"] == "18c0thread001"
    assert row["internal_date"] == 1730000000000 and row["has_attachments"] is True
    assert row["label_ids"] == json.dumps(row["labels"]) and row["sha256"] == msg.sha256


def test_index_row_upserts_with_merge_duplicates(tmp_path):
    post = FakePost(201)
    w = IndexWriter(post, ENDPOINT)
    r = w.index_row(workspace(tmp_path), {"id": "m1"})
    assert r.outcome == "written"
    assert post.calls == [("https://example.supabase.co/rest/v1/gmail_messages", {"id": "m1"})]


def test_index_row_off_for_personal_accounts(tmp_path):
    post = FakePost()
    assert IndexWriter(post, ENDPOINT).index_row(personal(tmp_path), {"id": "m1"}).outcome == "disabled"
    assert post.calls == []


def test_index_row_aborts_after_three_consecutive_401s(tmp_path):
    w = IndexWriter(FakePost(401), ENDPOINT)
    a = workspace(tmp_path)
    assert w.index_row(a, {"id": "1"}).outcome == "failed"
    assert w.index_row(a, {"id": "2"}).outcome == "failed"
    with pytest.raises(IndexAuthFailure):
        w.index_row(a, {"id": "3"})


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- resolve_contacts


def test_resolve_contacts_sends_each_counterparty_once_and_skips_owner(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("CONTACT_RESOLVER_ENFORCE", raising=False)
    post = FakePost()
    r = resolve_contacts(post, ENDPOINT, workspace(tmp_path), decode_raw(shape.message_raw("m1")))
    bodies = [b for _, b in post.calls]
    assert [(b["p_email"], b["p_name"], b["p_enforce"]) for b in bodies] == [
        ("pat@example.com", "Pat Example", False),
        ("lee@example.com", None, False),
    ]
    assert r.outcome == "written" and r.detail == {"linked": 2}
    assert "pat@example.com" not in r.line()


def test_resolve_contacts_off_for_personal_accounts(tmp_path):
    post = FakePost()
    r = resolve_contacts(post, ENDPOINT, personal(tmp_path), decode_raw(shape.message_raw("m1")))
    assert r.outcome == "disabled" and post.calls == []


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- enrichment queue


def test_enrichment_queue_off_by_default(tmp_path):
    post = FakePost()
    q = QueueEndpoint("https://example.com/hook", "tkn")
    r = publish_to_enrichment_queue(post, q, workspace(tmp_path), "k", shape.message_raw("m1"))
    assert (r.outcome, r.detail["reason"], post.calls) == ("disabled", "flag-off", [])


def test_enrichment_queue_enabled_without_webhook_never_posts(tmp_path):
    post = FakePost()
    a = workspace(tmp_path, GMAIL_SYNC_QUEUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED="true")
    r = publish_to_enrichment_queue(post, QueueEndpoint("", ""), a, "k", shape.message_raw("m1"))
    assert (r.outcome, post.calls) == ("disabled", [])


def test_enrichment_queue_enabled_posts_expected_payload(tmp_path):
    seen: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def post(url, json, headers, timeout):  # noqa: A002
        seen.update(url=url, json=json, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
        return Resp(200)

    a = workspace(tmp_path, GMAIL_SYNC_QUEUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED="true")
    r = publish_to_enrichment_queue(
        post, QueueEndpoint("https://example.com/hook", "tkn"), a, "ingestion/gmail/m1.eml",
        shape.message_raw("m1"), "IMPORTANT",
    )
    assert r.outcome == "written"
    assert seen["json"]["eventType"] == "EMAIL"
    assert seen["json"]["metadata"]["is_important"] is True
    assert seen["headers"]["Authorization"] == "Bearer tkn" and seen["timeout"] == 10


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- deposit parser (disabled)


def test_deposit_parser_reads_both_documented_formats():
    new = parse_altruist_deposit_notice(
        "New funds have arrived for Jo Example. A deposit of $1,800.00 into Jo Example's account"
    )
    old = parse_altruist_deposit_notice("Jo Example's $450.00 deposit is complete.")
    assert new == {"client_name": "Jo Example", "amount": 1800.0, "currency": "USD",
                   "altruist_account_id": None}
    assert old and old["amount"] == 450.0
    assert parse_altruist_deposit_notice("nothing here") is None


def test_deposit_acknowledger_does_nothing_unless_explicitly_enabled():
    post = FakePost()
    text = "Jo Example's $450.00 deposit is complete."
    assert deposit_notice.acknowledge_deposit(post, "https://x", "s", text) == "disabled"
    assert post.calls == []


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- pipeline


def _archive(tmp_path, account, gmail, post=None, r2=None):
    return MailboxArchive(account, gmail, r2 or FakeR2(), "lake", post=post or FakePost(),
                          supabase=ENDPOINT, queue=QueueEndpoint("", ""), clock=lambda: NOW)


def test_archive_message_workspace_runs_the_pre_split_steps_in_order(tmp_path):
    gmail = FakeGmail({"m1": shape.message_raw("m1")})
    receipts = _archive(tmp_path, workspace(tmp_path), gmail).archive_message("m1")
    assert [(r.behaviour, r.outcome) for r in receipts] == [
        ("archive_raw_message", "written"),
        ("archive_attachments", "written"),
        ("snapshot_labels", "disabled"),
        ("index_row", "written"),
        ("resolve_contacts", "written"),
        ("publish_to_enrichment_queue", "disabled"),
    ]


def test_archive_message_does_not_write_a_maildir(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    gmail = FakeGmail({"m1": shape.message_raw("m1")})
    _archive(tmp_path, workspace(tmp_path), gmail).archive_message("m1")
    assert not any(p.name.endswith(".meta.json") for p in tmp_path.rglob("*"))


def test_contacts_not_resolved_when_row_fails(tmp_path):
    gmail = FakeGmail({"m1": shape.message_raw("m1")})
    post = FakePost(500)
    receipts = _archive(tmp_path, workspace(tmp_path), gmail, post).archive_message("m1")
    assert "resolve_contacts" not in [r.behaviour for r in receipts]
    assert [u.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] for u, _ in post.calls] == ["gmail_messages"]


def test_archive_message_personal_writes_r2_only(tmp_path):
    gmail = FakeGmail({"m1": shape.message_raw("m1", labels=["SPAM"])})
    post, r2 = FakePost(), FakeR2()
    receipts = _archive(tmp_path, personal(tmp_path), gmail, post, r2).archive_message("m1")
    assert [r.outcome for r in receipts] == ["written", "written", "written", "disabled", "disabled"]
    assert post.calls == []
    assert all(k.startswith("ingestion/gmail-accounts/personal-1/") for k in r2.puts)


def test_backfill_phases_resume_tokens_and_spam_trash(tmp_path):
    msgs = {i: shape.message_raw(i) for i in ("s1", "s2", "x1")}
    gmail = FakeGmail(msgs, lists=[
        shape.messages_list(["s1"], next_page_token="p2"),
        shape.messages_list(["s2"]),
        shape.messages_list([]), shape.messages_list([]),
        shape.messages_list(["x1"]),
    ])
    arch = _archive(tmp_path, personal(tmp_path), gmail)
    assert arch.backfill() == 3
    assert [c.get("labelIds") for c in gmail.list_calls] == [
        ["SENT"], ["SENT"], ["STARRED"], ["IMPORTANT"], None]
    assert gmail.list_calls[1]["pageToken"] == "p2"
    assert all(c["includeSpamTrash"] is True for c in gmail.list_calls)
    state = json.loads(personal(tmp_path).state_file.read_text())
    assert state["historyId"] == "12345" and not any(k.startswith("pageToken") for k in state)


def test_backfill_workspace_excludes_spam_trash(tmp_path):
    gmail = FakeGmail({}, lists=[])
    _archive(tmp_path, workspace(tmp_path), gmail).backfill()
    assert all("includeSpamTrash" not in c for c in gmail.list_calls)


def test_incremental_pages_through_history_and_records_label_changes(tmp_path):
    a = personal(tmp_path)
    a.state_file.write_text(json.dumps({"historyId": "100"}))
    gmail = FakeGmail(
        {"m1": shape.message_raw("m1"), "m2": shape.message_raw("m2")},
        history=[
            shape.history_page([shape.history_message_added("101", "m1")], "110", "next"),
            shape.history_page([
                shape.history_message_added("102", "m2"),
                shape.history_label_added("103", "m1", ["SPAM"], ["SPAM"]),
            ], "110"),
        ],
    )
    r2 = FakeR2()
    arch = _archive(tmp_path, a, gmail, r2=r2)
    assert arch.incremental() == 3
    assert gmail.history_calls[0]["historyTypes"] == ["messageAdded", "labelAdded", "labelRemoved"]
    assert gmail.history_calls[1]["pageToken"] == "next"
    assert a.label_snapshot_key("m1", "103") in r2.objects
    assert json.loads(a.state_file.read_text())["historyId"] == "110"


def test_incremental_falls_back_to_backfill_on_expired_history(tmp_path):
    a = workspace(tmp_path)
    a.state_file.write_text(json.dumps({"historyId": "1"}))

    class Expired(Exception):
        resp = type("R", (), {"status": 404})()

    gmail = FakeGmail({}, lists=[], history=[Expired("gone")])
    _archive(tmp_path, a, gmail).incremental()
    assert len(gmail.list_calls) == 4  # the four backfill phases ran

class FakeR2:
    def __init__(self, present: set[str] | None = None, head_error: str = "404") -> None:
        self.objects: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {k: {} for k in (present or set())}
        self.puts: list[str] = []
        self.head_error = head_error

    def head_object(self, Bucket: str, Key: str) -> dict:  # noqa: N803 - boto3 names
        if Key in self.objects:
            return {}
        err = Exception("missing")
        err.response = {"Error": {"Code": self.head_error}, "ResponseMetadata": {}}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        raise err

    def put_object(self, Bucket: str, Key: str, Body: bytes, **kw: Any) -> None:  # noqa: N803
        self.objects[Key] = {"Body": Body, **kw}
        self.puts.append(Key)


class Resp:
    def __init__(self, status: int = 201, body: Any = None) -> None:
        self.status_code = status
        self.text = "x"
        self._body = body if body is not None else {"decision": "linked"}

    def json(self) -> Any:
        return self._body


class FakePost:
    def __init__(self, status: int = 201) -> None:
        self.status = status
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []

    def __call__(self, url: str, json: Any, headers: dict, timeout: float) -> Resp:  # noqa: A002
        self.calls.append((url, json))
        if url.endswith("/gmail_messages"):
            return Resp(self.status)
        return Resp(200)


class _Exec:
    def __init__(self, fn, kw):
        self.fn, self.kw = fn, kw

    def execute(self):
        return self.fn(**self.kw)


class FakeGmail:
    """users().messages()/history()/labels()/getProfile() over shape fixtures."""

    def __init__(self, messages: dict[str, dict], lists: list[dict] | None = None,
                 history: list[Any] | None = None) -> None:
        self.messages_by_id = messages
        self.lists = list(lists or [])
        self.history_pages = list(history or [])
        self.list_calls: list[dict] = []
        self.history_calls: list[dict] = []

    def users(self):
        return self

    def messages(self):
        return self

    def history(self):
        return self

    def labels(self):
        return _Labels()

    def get(self, **kw):
        return _Exec(lambda **k: self.messages_by_id[k["id"]], kw)

    def list(self, **kw):
        if "startHistoryId" in kw:
            def _h(**k):
                self.history_calls.append(k)
                page = self.history_pages.pop(0)
                if isinstance(page, Exception):
                    raise page
                return page
            return _Exec(_h, kw)

        def _l(**k):
            self.list_calls.append(k)
            return self.lists.pop(0) if self.lists else {"resultSizeEstimate": 0}
        return _Exec(_l, kw)

    def getProfile(self, **kw):  # noqa: N802 - Gmail API name

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- fakes


class FakeR2:
    def __init__(self, present: set[str] | None = None, head_error: str = "404") -> None:
        self.objects: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {k: {} for k in (present or set())}
        self.puts: list[str] = []
        self.head_error = head_error

    def head_object(self, Bucket: str, Key: str) -> dict:  # noqa: N803 - boto3 names
        if Key in self.objects:
            return {}
        err = Exception("missing")
        err.response = {"Error": {"Code": self.head_error}, "ResponseMetadata": {}}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        raise err

    def put_object(self, Bucket: str, Key: str, Body: bytes, **kw: Any) -> None:  # noqa: N803
        self.objects[Key] = {"Body": Body, **kw}
        self.puts.append(Key)


class Resp:
    def __init__(self, status: int = 201, body: Any = None) -> None:
        self.status_code = status
        self.text = "x"
        self._body = body if body is not None else {"decision": "linked"}

    def json(self) -> Any:
        return self._body


class FakePost:
    def __init__(self, status: int = 201) -> None:
        self.status = status
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []

    def __call__(self, url: str, json: Any, headers: dict, timeout: float) -> Resp:  # noqa: A002
        self.calls.append((url, json))
        if url.endswith("/gmail_messages"):
            return Resp(self.status)
        return Resp(200)


class _Exec:
    def __init__(self, fn, kw):
        self.fn, self.kw = fn, kw

    def execute(self):
        return self.fn(**self.kw)


class FakeGmail:
    """users().messages()/history()/labels()/getProfile() over shape fixtures."""

    def __init__(self, messages: dict[str, dict], lists: list[dict] | None = None,
                 history: list[Any] | None = None) -> None:
        self.messages_by_id = messages
        self.lists = list(lists or [])
        self.history_pages = list(history or [])
        self.list_calls: list[dict] = []
        self.history_calls: list[dict] = []

    def users(self):
        return self

    def messages(self):
        return self

    def history(self):
        return self

    def labels(self):
        return _Labels()

    def get(self, **kw):
        return _Exec(lambda **k: self.messages_by_id[k["id"]], kw)

    def list(self, **kw):
        if "startHistoryId" in kw:
            def _h(**k):
                self.history_calls.append(k)
                page = self.history_pages.pop(0)
                if isinstance(page, Exception):
                    raise page
                return page
            return _Exec(_h, kw)

        def _l(**k):
            self.list_calls.append(k)
            return self.lists.pop(0) if self.lists else {"resultSizeEstimate": 0}
        return _Exec(_l, kw)

    def getProfile(self, **kw):  # noqa: N802 - Gmail API name
        return _Exec(lambda **k: {"emailAddress": shape.OWNER, "historyId": "12345"}, kw)


class _Labels:
    def list(self, **kw):
        return _Exec(lambda **k: shape.labels_list(), kw)


def workspace(tmp_path: Path, **extra: str):
    return account_from_env({"GMAIL_ARCHIVE_STATE_FILE": str(tmp_path / "s.json"),
                             "ACCOUNT_EMAIL": shape.OWNER, **extra})


def personal(tmp_path: Path, **extra: str):
    return account_from_env({
        "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_AUTH": "refresh_token",
        "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_ACCOUNT_SLUG": "personal-1",
        "ACCOUNT_EMAIL": "someone@gmail.example",
        "GMAIL_ARCHIVE_STATE_FILE": str(tmp_path / "p.json"),
        **extra,
    })


ENDPOINT = RestEndpoint("https://example.supabase.co", "test-key")
NOW = "2026-11-05T00:00:00+00:00"

    a = account_from_env({})
    assert (a.auth, a.slug, a.email) == ("delegated", "workspace", "sloane@ethicic.com")
    assert a.raw_key("m1") == "ingestion/gmail/m1.eml"
    assert a.attachment_key("abc", "f.pdf") == "ingestion/gmail/attachments/abc-f.pdf"
    assert str(a.state_file) == "/state/gmail_sync_state.json"
    assert a.history_types == ("messageAdded",)
    assert not a.include_spam_trash and not a.snapshot_labels
    assert a.index_rows and a.resolve_contacts and not a.publish_enrichment


def test_personal_defaults_archive_everything_but_stay_out_of_business_tables(tmp_path):
    a = personal(tmp_path)
    assert a.raw_key("m1") == "ingestion/gmail-accounts/personal-1/m1.eml"
    assert a.include_spam_trash and a.snapshot_labels
    assert a.history_types == ("messageAdded", "labelAdded", "labelRemoved")
    assert not a.index_rows and not a.resolve_contacts and not a.publish_enrichment

def test_archive_raw_message_writes_once_then_skips(tmp_path):
    a, r2 = workspace(tmp_path), FakeR2()
    msg = decode_raw(shape.message_raw("m1"))
    first = archive_raw_message(r2, "lake", a, msg)
    second = archive_raw_message(r2, "lake", a, msg)
    assert (first.outcome, second.outcome) == ("written", "skipped")
    assert r2.puts == ["ingestion/gmail/m1.eml"]
    stored = r2.objects["ingestion/gmail/m1.eml"]
    assert stored["Body"] == msg.raw and stored["ContentType"] == "message/rfc822"
    assert stored["Metadata"]["sha256"] == msg.sha256

def test_record_label_change_captures_spam_marking_and_unmarking(tmp_path):

def _archive(tmp_path, account, gmail, post=None, r2=None):
    return MailboxArchive(account, gmail, r2 or FakeR2(), "lake", post=post or FakePost(),
                          supabase=ENDPOINT, queue=QueueEndpoint("", ""), clock=lambda: NOW)


def test_archive_message_workspace_runs_the_pre_split_steps_in_order(tmp_path):
    gmail = FakeGmail({"m1": shape.message_raw("m1")})
    receipts = _archive(tmp_path, workspace(tmp_path), gmail).archive_message("m1")
    assert [(r.behaviour, r.outcome) for r in receipts] == [
        ("archive_raw_message", "written"),
        ("archive_attachments", "written"),
        ("snapshot_labels", "disabled"),
        ("index_row", "written"),
        ("resolve_contacts", "written"),
        ("publish_to_enrichment_queue", "disabled"),
    ]

def test_backfill_phases_resume_tokens_and_spam_trash(tmp_path):
    msgs = {i: shape.message_raw(i) for i in ("s1", "s2", "x1")}
    gmail = FakeGmail(msgs, lists=[
        shape.messages_list(["s1"], next_page_token="p2"),
        shape.messages_list(["s2"]),
        shape.messages_list([]), shape.messages_list([]),
        shape.messages_list(["x1"]),
    ])
    arch = _archive(tmp_path, personal(tmp_path), gmail)
    assert arch.backfill() == 3
    assert [c.get("labelIds") for c in gmail.list_calls] == [
        ["SENT"], ["SENT"], ["STARRED"], ["IMPORTANT"], None]
    assert gmail.list_calls[1]["pageToken"] == "p2"
    assert all(c["includeSpamTrash"] is True for c in gmail.list_calls)
    state = json.loads(personal(tmp_path).state_file.read_text())
    assert state["historyId"] == "12345" and not any(k.startswith("pageToken") for k in state)


def test_backfill_workspace_excludes_spam_trash(tmp_path):
    gmail = FakeGmail({}, lists=[])
    _archive(tmp_path, workspace(tmp_path), gmail).backfill()
    assert all("includeSpamTrash" not in c for c in gmail.list_calls)


def test_incremental_pages_through_history_and_records_label_changes(tmp_path):
    a = personal(tmp_path)
    a.state_file.write_text(json.dumps({"historyId": "100"}))
    gmail = FakeGmail(
        {"m1": shape.message_raw("m1"), "m2": shape.message_raw("m2")},
        history=[
            shape.history_page([shape.history_message_added("101", "m1")], "110", "next"),
            shape.history_page([
                shape.history_message_added("102", "m2"),
                shape.history_label_added("103", "m1", ["SPAM"], ["SPAM"]),
            ], "110"),
        ],
    )
    r2 = FakeR2()
    arch = _archive(tmp_path, a, gmail, r2=r2)
    assert arch.incremental() == 3
    assert gmail.history_calls[0]["historyTypes"] == ["messageAdded", "labelAdded", "labelRemoved"]
    assert gmail.history_calls[1]["pageToken"] == "next"
    assert a.label_snapshot_key("m1", "103") in r2.objects
    assert json.loads(a.state_file.read_text())["historyId"] == "110"


def test_incremental_falls_back_to_backfill_on_expired_history(tmp_path):
    a = workspace(tmp_path)
    a.state_file.write_text(json.dumps({"historyId": "1"}))

    class Expired(Exception):
        resp = type("R", (), {"status": 404})()

    gmail = FakeGmail({}, lists=[], history=[Expired("gone")])
    _archive(tmp_path, a, gmail).incremental()
    assert len(gmail.list_calls) == 4  # the four backfill phases ran


def test_one_bad_message_does_not_stop_the_walk_but_auth_failure_does(tmp_path):
    gmail = FakeGmail({"ok": shape.message_raw("ok")},
                      lists=[shape.messages_list(["missing", "ok"])])
    arch = _archive(tmp_path, workspace(tmp_path), gmail)
    assert arch._archive_or_log("missing") is False
    assert arch._archive_or_log("ok") is True

    arch401 = _archive(tmp_path, workspace(tmp_path),
                       FakeGmail({"ok": shape.message_raw("ok")}), FakePost(401))
    arch401.index.auth_failures = 2
    with pytest.raises(IndexAuthFailure):
        arch401._archive_or_log("ok")

"""gmail_sync.py is now a compatibility shim over dark.mailbox_archive.

The behaviour tests moved with the behaviours, to
packages/python/tests/test_mailbox_archive.py. What stays here is the
contract other code relies on: dark.email_ingest.recovery.BACKFILL_SNIPPET
does ``from gmail_sync import GmailSync`` inside the container and uses
``.service`` and ``._process_message(id)``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from dark.email_ingest.recovery import BACKFILL_SNIPPET

SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"


def _load(name: str):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, SRC / f"{name}.py")
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


class _Archive:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.gmail = object()
        self.account = type("A", (), {"email": "owner@example.org"})()
        self.calls: list[Any] = []

    def archive_message(self, msg_id, label_hint=None):
        self.calls.append((msg_id, label_hint))

    def backfill(self):
        self.calls.append("backfill")

    def incremental(self):
        self.calls.append("incremental")


def test_recovery_snippet_still_targets_the_shim():
    assert "from gmail_sync import GmailSync" in BACKFILL_SNIPPET
    assert "sync._process_message(ref['id'])" in BACKFILL_SNIPPET
    assert "sync.service" in BACKFILL_SNIPPET


def test_gmail_sync_shim_delegates_to_mailbox_archive(monkeypatch):
    mod = _load("gmail_sync")
    fake = _Archive()
    monkeypatch.setattr(mod, "build_from_env", lambda: fake)
    sync = mod.GmailSync()
    assert sync.service is fake.gmail
    sync._process_message("m1")
    sync._process_message("m2", label_hint="SENT")
    sync.sync_full_history()
    sync.sync_incremental()
    assert fake.calls == [("m1", None), ("m2", "SENT"), "backfill", "incremental"]


def test_shim_has_no_maildir_write():
    text = (SRC / "gmail_sync.py").read_text()
    assert "maildir" not in text.lower().replace("maildir copy", "")


def test_new_entry_point_runs_the_shared_job():
    assert "from dark.mailbox_archive.job import main" in (
        SRC / "gmail_mailbox_archive.py"
    ).read_text()
EOF

no /opt/vm-updater, no /srv/monocloud checkout. Until the updater is installed
there, this directory is a declaration and nothing applies it.

(2) The host secret file does not exist yet. /srv/mail-sync/docker-compose.yaml
currently inlines ~10 credentials as literals; they must be rendered into
/etc/monocloud/mail-sync.env (0600 root) from BWS first. Five of the keys the
live file sets are NOT in BWS — see README.md § "Keys the host env file must
supply" — so the cutover needs a decision on those, not just a copy.

(3) Adoption vs replacement is planned but unproven. The service KEYS already
match (gmail-sync / calendar-sync / contacts-sync) and the compose project name
matches this directory, but `container_name`, the four state volumes and the
network still carry Coolify's hash. This file preserves all of them so a first
apply adopts rather than creating a parallel set — gmail-maildir holds real
mail, so getting this wrong is data loss, not a reset. Verify with a
`docker compose --project-name mail-sync ... config` diff ON THE BOX before
applying.

the open full-resync bug (ETH-2jfjv).

# email-archiver — daily archive + label + threshold tuning
# Source: rawls /home/srvo/dev/monocloud/scripts/cron/email-actions.sh (06:30 UTC)
# Migrated to Coolify supercronic (ETH-1483) on rawls retirement.
30 6 * * * /app/.venv/bin/python /app/archive.py
"""Email actions service — archive + label emails based on triage scores.

Runs on rawls via cron (after triage-scorer). Single-run, not a daemon.

POLICY: We NEVER delete email. Archive = remove INBOX label.
Messages remain in Gmail's All Mail and can always be found via search.
Labels are additive only — we never remove a label a human applied.

Batch-optimized: Gmail API calls use `new_batch_http_request()` (up to 100
per batch). DB commits are batched every 50 emails instead of per-row.
A 500-email run completes in ~10-20 seconds instead of 3-5 minutes.

Phase 1 — Archive + classify:
  1. Find high-confidence automated/marketing emails
  2. Apply classification label (marketing, vendor, etc.) + auto-archived
  3. Remove from INBOX
  4. Log to comms.email_archive_log

Phase 2 — Label inbox:
  1. Apply identity labels from correspondent_registry (client, prospect, vendor)
  2. Apply triage labels from email_ai_scores (needs action, research, marketing)
  3. Update correspondent_registry with label timestamps
  4. Log to comms.email_label_log

Phase 4 — Dynamic threshold tuning:

# Mail ingestion map Every mail job in the repository: what it reads, what it writes, what triggers it, and where the repository says it is deployed. This page is based on the repository alone, at the revision that added it. **Nothing here proves a job is running.** "Deployment as documented" quotes what files claim; some of those claims contradict each other, and the contradictions are listed as they stand. Paths are relative to the repository root. ## The short version - **Two producers write new mail into `comms.gmail_messages`:** - **gmail-mailbox-archive**, formerly "Gmail sync", polls the Gmail API for one mailbox. - The **Cloudflare inbox worker** receives routed mail. - Two more jobs write the same table, either as a backstop or behind a flag: - **r2_supabase_reconcile** backstops the worker. - **mail-sync** writes back only when its reverse mode is on. - **gmail_gap_autobackfill** re-drives gmail-mailbox-archive's own code. It is the same writer, not a separate one. - Only **mail-sync** (Rust, Stalwart importer) has a deployment definition in the repository that reads as current: a systemd unit plus a deploy script for the arendt `mail` CT. - **gmail-mailbox-archive** has no current deployment definition: - Its replacement compose file is marked "NOT YET APPLIED". - The live container is described as an orphaned Coolify render, last built 2026-08-19. - Every Coolify reference is stale. Coolify no longer exists. The `claude/remove-coolify` branch is removing those references. - **The critical-crons jobs** are declared on host `ops`. One of them, gmail_gap_autobackfill, finds its target with `docker ps` on the local socket. gmail-sync is declared on host `comms`. As written, the lookup cannot find the container from `ops` (details in §3). ## Jobs ### 1. gmail-mailbox-archive (formerly gmail-sync / "Gmail sync") | | | |---|---| | Code | `packages/python/dark/mailbox_archive/` (behaviours). The entry points are `infra/containers/python/email/src/gmail_mailbox_archive.py` and the compatibility shim `src/gmail_sync.py`. | | Reads | The Gmail API for **one** mailbox: `messages.list` for backfill, `history.list` for increments, `messages.get` with `format=raw`, and `labels.list`. State is a JSON file holding `historyId` and page tokens. The workspace account keeps `/state/gmail_sync_state.json`. | | Writes | **R2 `lake`:** `ingestion/gmail/.eml` and `ingestion/gmail/attachments/-`. **Contact resolver RPC:** shadow mode unless `CONTACT_RESOLVER_ENFORCE=1`.
**Legacy enrichment webhook:** off by default. | | No longer writes | `/maildir/new/*.eml` and `*.meta.json`, which fed the Notmuch indexer. A filed marker on `comms.gmail_messages`. A `PipelineRun` row. | | Trigger | Manual CLI.
